text:
kevin: deploy-bot flagged a mini-canary failure in eu-west-1 after the canary rollout. sample-replay probe failing ~40% of sampled requests.

deploy-bot: canary-group mini-1 -> postdeploy sample-replay: FAIL (p95 latency 230ms, errors 5.6%)

vivian: saw something similar in staging last week, suspect a kv-prefill edge-case when driving q8-narrow model variant under burst.

kevin: ok. what's the blast radius? production traffic still on stable route?

sre-oncall: prod traffic remains on stable for now. canary only. but we see backend thrash patterns consistent with prefix cache churn (CPU + GC blips).

vivian: repro locally with the small replay harness: set `--ratio 0.02` against canary endpoint to mimic mini-canary load.

```
./replay --target https://canary-eu-1.redwood.internal --ratio 0.02 --seed 42
```

vivian: replay logs show repeated `KV_PREFILL` spikes and `model-variant=q8-narrow` appearing in the trace. memory climb then short OOM-ish GC pauses.

kevin: options: (1) disable kv-prefill for q8 variant in canary (feature-flag flip), (2) rollback the canary, (3) pin routing back to stable pool. thoughts?

sre-oncall: i'd prefer option 1 as a surgical hotfix. lower risk than a full rollback and buys time for a proper fix. can be toggled via infra-api quickly.

vivian: i can push the flag change: `kv.prefill.enabled=false` scoped to canary pool and then re-run replay. planning small 10k request replay.

kevin: go for it. if replay looks good, hold rollout window for observation, then resume.

deploy-bot: change submitted: deploy-change/6142009999-kv-prefill-toggle by vivian (scope: canary-eu-west-1)

vivian: quick replay completed: p95 dropped to ~115ms, errors <0.5% now :thumbsup: will keep streaming logs for 15m.

kevin: great. placing rollout on a 30m observational hold. @sre-oncall please monitor p50/p95, cpu, and error rates. set temporary alerts.

sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards pinned. alert thresholds set: p95 > 180ms OR errors > 1% -> auto-rollback. will escalate immediately if triggered.

kevin: i'll update release notes and annotate the change window: "6142009999 - mini-canary hold due to kv-prefill churn; feature-flag flip applied". any objections to resuming after 30m if stable?

vivian: no objections. i'll open a follow-up ticket to implement a proper q8 memory safety fix and revert the feature flag once that lands.

kevin: thanks. leaving this thread. if the alert fires, page infra rotation. filing follow-up: RN-6142 (note: update release notes and changelog).

sre-oncall: ack. monitoring oncall channel and alerting.

(reactor: :eyes: from kevin, :rocket: from vivian)
